## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed sector returns (Real Estate, Consumer Staples, Industrials up vs Tech, Comm, Financials down) and concentrated top-performer mix confirm a neutral, non-directional market.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Real Estate lead: AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +10.92%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND. Technology soft: MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND. Financials under pressure: WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -9.48%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND. Note AMZN in CORRECTION (1W: -3.34% | 1M: +7.44%) signals short-term distribution despite 1M strength.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed, tipping toward weakness on the week: NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND contrast with MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND and QCOM (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -9.48%) BELOW TREND; watch for further dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Patchy: BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND and select banks show strength while WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND and card names V (1W: -6.14% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND are weak — internal rotation within the sector.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Mixed defensive bid but not uniform: JNJ (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.47%) ABOVE TREND offset ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -1.51%) BELOW TREND; sector is internally bifurcated.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Given NEUTRAL regime and mixed leadership, favor exposure to Industrials and select Real Estate/Energy names showing ABOVE TREND (LMT, AMT, XOM) and reduce exposure to lagging large-cap Tech (MSFT, ADBE, CRM) while monitoring NVDA/AMD momentum; style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.24% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +3.43%) and Real Estate (1W: +4.41%) given strong weekly leadership. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.14%) and Communication (1W: -3.79%) where large-cap weakness could widen dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) needs sustained weekly follow-through to keep ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) failing to reclaim 1M trend would keep it BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) must hold 1W gains to avoid a sharp mean reversion; JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) needs to stabilize on a weekly basis to prevent deeper BELOW TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
LLY (+55): Eli Lilly trial news; price 1W: -2.37% | 1M: -1.51% BELOW TREND — sentiment positive but price not yet confirming (divergence). HON (+65): upgrade cited; price data not listed in the provided summary for cross-check. ORCL (+50): analyst confidence on cloud/AI; price data not listed in the provided summary for cross-check.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTU (-50): Wells Fargo downgrade; price 1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38% BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by heavy price weakness. AAPL (-45): regulatory headwinds in India; price 1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95% BELOW TREND — sentiment aligns with price weakness. WFC (-45): regulatory/credit-card policy risk; price 1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13% BELOW TREND — negative sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) and AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) showing strength while MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) and INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) show clear weakness. Key risk: narrow/concentrated leadership and headline-driven sentiment divergences (LLY positive on news but price BELOW TREND; INTU downgrade confirming sharp price decline).
